title: HB 1897 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2, relative to voter registration.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) not stated.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) Sec 1, new 2-2-141(f)(1) (every applicant checked against SAVE; checked by the county commission)
(quote) Each county election commission shall check each applicant for registration with the systematic alien verification for entitlements (SAVE) program database prior to placing a registrant on the voter rolls in order to ensure non-United States citizens are not registered to vote in the county.
(section) Sec 1, 2-2-141(f)(2) (whole list each quarter)
(quote) At least once each quarter, the county election commission shall check the county's entire voter registration list through the SAVE program database to ensure that non-United States citizens are not on the voter rolls in the county.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Preamble (WHEREAS clauses): SAVE is open to county election officials, free, and accepts batches.
(other) Sec 2: effective on becoming law.
(other) The bill does not say what happens to a registrant the check flags, and asks nobody for documents.
(other) version: 3328105-Draft (2026-01-22): carries slot d (SAVE check of each applicant and the full list each quarter).
(other) version: 3329448-Draft (2026-01-22): same words; header adds companion Senate Bill 2124 (Bowling).
(other) note: Failed in the House Elections & Campaign Finance Subcommittee on 2026-03-10, 1 yes, 6 no. No amendment is recorded; the vote was on the Draft.
(note) Off this topic: the bill sets no ID or citizenship-proof rule.
